{{Top}}
[[File:SullustanJedi-GH.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] practicing meditation.]]
{{Quote|Where do you go when you meditate?''"<br />"''To a state of mind and body, where I reacquaint myself with simplicity.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
'''Meditation''' was a mental technique practiced by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and non-[[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitives alike, by which one attempted to get beyond the reflexive, "thinking" mind into a deeper state of relaxation or awareness. Many Force-based organizations, such as the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], used meditation for enhancing emotional control over self and for better connection to the Force. Members of these and other groups often built [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chambers]] in which outside disturbances could be muted and shut out to provide a more conducive atmosphere for deep meditation. While meditation could be attained without any outside means, some individuals chose to meditate with the assistance of a rare, naturally occurring [[meditation crystal]].

==History==
===Jedi Order===
[[File:MeditationBracelet-TNR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Twi'lek Jedi wearing a [[meditation bracelet]] as a focus point of meditation]]
Meditation within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was considered paramount to mastering oneself and the Third Pillar of the Jedi Path: Self-Discipline. Without self-mastery, Jedi scholars would argue that achieving mastery over the Force would be impossible. To the Jedi, meditation allows a practitioner to achieve inner peace, harmony, and serenity; three of the core principles of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. Due to the importance on meditation, the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] created a five sessions-a-day meditation regimen for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] within the [[Jedi academy|academies]] of the Order to ensure that the necessity was driven home. Initiates and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were then encouraged by their [[Jedi instructor|instructors]] to meditate whenever they had a spare moment, seeking deeper meditation during private time.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

===Sith Order===
Similar to the Jedi Order, the members of the [[Sith Order]] as it existed across the millennium employed meditation to focus and sharpen their mind, regain their strength, and heal their wounds. Forsaking all attempts to eliminate passions and gain serenity, Sith often times used their dark and raw emotions to reinvigorate themselves and stoke the flames of passion which burned within their souls. Over their history, many notable [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] have meditated privately within a specially-made [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]] within their palaces or aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Most notably, the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] had learned to create [[Sith Meditation Sphere|meditation sphere]]; mobile war craft used by Sith employing the complicated art of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]].<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] grew in the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to the point where he almost never [[Sleep/Legends|slept]], relying instead on an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] or two of [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] meditation to keep his body energized and his mind invigorated.<ref name="Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

===Gand Findsmen===
[[File:Venlyss_Pnorr.png|thumb|right|150px|Findsman [[Venlyss Pnorr]] practices a meditation ritual.]]
An organization of [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] operating on their [[Gand (planet)/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Findsman/Legends|Findsmen]] worshiped the mists of their home, attributing the mysteries of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to this shroud of fog. Among the Findsmen individual meditations were kept private and secret,<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> with rituals lasting for an uninterrupted three hours.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Through such rituals the Gand opened themselves up to the Force, drawing on energies which could be focused into other abilities, such as [[battlemind]] or [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]].<ref name="AA" /> Knowledge gained through Findsmen meditations was said to have a statistically high accuracy rate; the notorious Findsmen [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] was calculated to have a high accuracy rate of 91.33725.<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

A Findsman's meditation session typically began with the regulation of the respiration rate, allowing the practitioner to slowly enter a calm state where the mists of Gand could easily swirl about their mind. As the vision presented itself, the mists would recede and information could be read. A unique quality of the Findsmen meditations was dependent on where the ritual took place. Those who meditated within a crowded city were said to become mindful of the actions of those around them. In contrast, meditation in planetary orbit granted the practitioner the ability to have foreknowledge of planetary cultures and customs. Some rituals took place during trips through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]; Findsmen claimed that these rituals allowed them to sense the underlying feelings motivating [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] countless sentients.<ref name="OPF" />

===Nightsisters===
The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], a secluded group of [[Witches of Dathomir|Force witches]] focused their studies on the Force through their meditations on the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|green spirits]]. This thin veil of green mist which permeated Nightsister temples and convents aided them when preforming such feats as the [[Surge of the Brier|surge of the brier]].<ref name="BOS" />

==Variants==
===Meditation of Emptiness===
{{Main|Meditation of Emptiness}}
[[File:Ancient_Monument_TCG_by_Cynthie_Sheppard.png|thumb|left|240px|A Jedi practicing meditation near an ancient monument.]]
A technique employed by the Jedi Order, Empty Meditation was recommended to students as a means to center oneself and find deep inner peace and purge negative emotions. Establishing an emotional anchor, Jedi used the technique for centuries despite purges and war. The famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] highly recommended the technique,<ref name="TJP" /> while members of the Order continued the practice well past the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

A similar technique developed by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after the [[New Jedi Order|reformation]] of the Order was called [[heji tal]]. Drawing on all three fundamental skills of the Jedi teachings: control, sense, and alter, heji tal saw these skills focused upon in ever-changing patterns. Like Empty Meditation, heji tal brought inner peace, knowledge, and serenity.<ref name="TJP" />

===Moving Meditation===
{{Main|Moving Meditation}}
{{Quote|There are others who may achieve this in occupying the mind, in achieving a moving meditation where operating on machinery achieves a similar effect.|[[Kreia]]|<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The art of Moving Meditation was a technique practiced in a state of wakefulness at which time a practitioner quieted all external distractions consciously by performing an activity involving movement coupled with concentration. Moving Meditation could manifest itself in many different ways, awakening a feeling in the user that they could complete any task they were faced with.<ref name="TJP" /> Moving Meditation practices ranged from repairing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] or [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Meetra Surik]] were fond of doing. Surik, a Jedi during the [[Jedi Civil War]], would often enter into the trance while tinkering with her personal [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] [[T3-M4]], while her companion [[Bao-Dur]] could only find a serene calm while working on machinery.<ref name="KOTORII" />

A more refined and personal form of Moving Meditation originated at [[Stav Kesh]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the time before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Known as [[Alchaka]], this deeply complex exercise involved seemingly endless repetitions of intense stances which left the practitioner exhausted.<ref name="Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> Used by non-Jedi groups, a similar form of Moving Meditation was developed by the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]]. A type of meditative martial arts, this technique was often employed while wearing a [[Matukai meditation band|meditation band]] around the head.<ref name="KOTORII" />

===Floating Meditation===
{{Main|Floating Meditation}}
[[File:Mystical_energies_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|210px|A Togruta Jedi using both floating meditation and moving meditation.]]

The art of [[Floating Meditation|floating]] or rising meditation was a rare technique for students of the Force to achieve. Attainable only once deeply submerged in the Force, this form of meditation allowed practitioners to rise several meters off the ground. also known as "Rising Meditation" - a technique where Jedi meditated while using the Force to float several inches off the ground.<ref name="TJP" />

While teaching her young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] instructed her apprentice to meditate behind a low wall until she could see the shop on the other side. Struggling for hours to achieve Rising meditation, Offee was shocked to discover her master's task was far simpler. Unduli explained that it is unnecessary to float over the low wall to see the shop when she could simply stand.<ref name="MedStar Duology">[[MedStar Duology]]</ref>

===Healing meditation===
{{Main|Healing meditation}}
[[Healing meditation]] or a healing trance was a method of [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] ones injuries with the Force. Some species, such as [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]], had a natural affinity for healing themselves through trances, while other organizations taught the skill to their acolytes.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 9">[[Star Wars (1998) 9|''Star Wars'' (1998) 9]]</ref>
